taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: Session fixation and lifecycle controls — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read session issuance/rotation, cookie/token binding, refresh-family state and logout/revocation. Determine what invalidation the product promises after login, privilege change, reset and logout.
controls.controlled_verification: Track two owned sessions and exact identifiers across one declared transition. Compare the prior session's access to a protected fixture before/after that transition, then check the new intended session. For fixation, prove that an attacker-influenced preauth identifier survives into a victim-authorized session; identifier equality alone is incomplete.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A stateless token remaining valid until its documented short expiry is not automatically a broken logout promise. A browser deleting its cookie is different from server-side revocation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Implement the declared rotation/revocation boundary and atomically constrain refresh reuse where required. Retest the original prior credential, replacement session and unrelated valid sessions under that policy.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
